name: Karl Morris Scholarship
summary: Up to $5,000 for financially disadvantaged Griffith business, commerce and financial planning students from second year.
key: Maximum value is $5,000, paid in instalments.
who: Australian citizen, permanent resident or Permanent Humanitarian Visa holder.
Commencing at least second year of the program (minimum 80 CP completed).
Not receiving any other scholarship funding.
how: Apply through Griffith's online scholarship application process.
Include a CV and Centrelink statements or other evidence of financial hardship.
